name: How can I soundproof an interior partition wall during framing?

mainEntity.name: How can I soundproof an interior partition wall during framing?

acceptedAnswer.text: To keep noise from traveling through a partition wall, combine dense mineral wool batt insulation inside the stud bays with specialized installation methods. Standard hollow walls transmit sound easily through air cavities and stud vibration. Practical solutions include staggered stud framing, resilient sound-isolation channels attached across studs prior to drywall, or dual layers of 5/8-inch drywall joined by damping compound. Sealing top and bottom plate perimeters with acoustic sealant stops sound leakage through hidden gaps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install dense mineral wool batts in stud bays, apply resilient channels before hanging drywall, and caulk perimeter plate joints with acoustic sealant to isolate sound transmission.
